```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(gradethis)
library(shiny)

gradethis::gradethis_setup()
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Section A

### Question 1

```{r q1, echo=FALSE}
question(
  "What is the standard assignment operator in R?",
  answer("<-", correct = TRUE),
  answer("="),
  answer("->"),
  answer(":="),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

### Question 22

```{r q22, echo=FALSE}
question(
  "What is 'lazy evaluation' in R?",
  answer("Function arguments are evaluated only when they are actually needed within the function execution.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("R delays memory allocation for variables until the script is fully written."),
  answer("Packages are not loaded into memory until a function within them is called."),
  answer("Garbage collection is deferred until R runs completely out of memory."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

### Question 23

```{r q23, echo=FALSE}

  answer("Reference Classes (RC)"),
  answer("R6"),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q24, echo=FALSE}
)
```
